method: Exact demo prose translations in GET responses only; identifiers, states, dates and observed outcomes are unchanged.

mapping.Make the website usable without a mouse: Make the website usable without a mouse
mapping.Open the contact link from the website f: Open the contact link from the website footer. It should open the email composer with the published contact address. Record the browser and result before closing this demonstration task.
mapping.Demonstration check: this browser preser: Demonstration check: this browser preserves the saved manual plan after reload. The member can read it; a non-owner invitation request is rejected with HTTP 403. This comment records the observed application checks, not an email composer test.
mapping.Use Tab to reach the navigation links, s: Use Tab to reach the navigation links, search field and issue controls. Check that focus is visible.
